reasons: open finding claude-verify:row-never-observed-by-resize-observer is bucket A or BLOCKER

needs_human.note: The beside exception in rowBlockPx returns 0 when data-row-beside is on. The spec's rowBlock formula has no such case. It is invisible today, because beside requires a panel shown and the cap is then half of H.; The MutationObserver watches childList only. A change to data-row-beside alone does not trigger measure(); it relies on the ResizeObserver on the row. If the row keeps the same height across a beside toggle, rowBlock can be stale. Not verified.; With no miniPlayerRoot the scope is document, so the observer runs on every DOM insertion or removal in the page.

The row's beside state (data-row-beside=on) yields rowBlock 0, which the spec's formula does not state.; The MutationObserver with subtree over the whole document runs a querySelector on every DOM mutation, outside the spec's description.; When the row's height changes without its element changing and without an observed element resizing, --player-avail stays stale until a window resize.
